heading.title: Of Transfers of Property by Act of Parties1

article.title: When unborn person acquires vested interest on transfer for his benefit.
article.content: Where, on a transfer of property, an interest therein is created for the benefit of a person not then living, he acquires upon his birth, unless a contrary intention appear from the terms of the transfer, a vested interest, although he may not be entitled to the enjoyment thereof immediately on his birth.
article.html:
20When unborn person acquires vested interest on transfer for his benefit.

Section 20 · Chapter II · (A) Transfer of Property, whether moveable or immoveable · page 13 of the Act

Where, on a transfer of property, an interest therein is created for the benefit of a person not then living, he acquires upon his birth, unless a contrary intention appear from the terms of the transfer, a vested interest, although he may not be entitled to the enjoyment thereof immediately on his birth.
